note: Verified local corrections to the upstream NPC catalog's boss/role flags, kept here so a catalog refresh does not re-introduce the error. Each entry's fields merge over the generated record in data/i18n/npcs. isBoss:false means the NPC must not headline an encounter as its boss; role records the intended major/miniboss/world-boss distinction, which the catalog itself does not yet carry.
